{{Quote|I was Merellis, a come-up flector for a swoop gang on Caprioril. That's where I was when a female cyborg found me. She wanted to bring me back to Isard. I didn't want to go. So I didn't. Cyborg got my lightsaber but not me.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] to [[Tionne Solusar|Tionne]]|<ref name="JvS" />}}
The '''Confrontation on Caprioril''' was a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] that took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caprioril]]<ref name="TEP" /> between rogue [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]]-turned [[Swoop gang/Legends|Swoop gang]] [[come-up flector]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]<ref name="JvS" /> and [[Lumiya]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]], some time after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEP" />

Sent by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Regent/Legends|steward]] [[Ysanne Isard]] to bring Jade back under Imperial service, Lumiya tracked and confronted her opponent on Caprioril, where Jade refused to comply with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady's]] wishes. A [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] ensued,<ref name="TEP" /> but ultimately ended in a draw.<ref name="JvS" />

During the duel, Mara lost the magenta [[Mara Jade's first lightsaber|lightsaber]]<ref name="JvS" /> she had constructed with a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] gave her.<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>
